parsed.rationale: The cluster identifies an exact function-duplicate signal between `WXYCTVApp.buildConfiguration` in `WXYC/WXYC TV/WXYCTVApp.swift` (package `app:WXYC TV`) and `WXYCApp.buildConfiguration` in `WXYC/iOS/WXYCApp.swift` (package `app:iOS`). Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flags, so the duplication is not intentional by policy. Because both app targets share the same repository root and the method name and body are structurally identical, the implementation should be extracted into a shared location — ideally a common Swift file or module both targets already depend on — and each app entry point should delegate to that shared implementation. This eliminates the risk of the two copies diverging silently as configuration logic evolves.
